description: Verify that TCP in FIN-WAIT-2 returns ACK with proper SEQ/ACK numbers after receiving a segment with OTW SEQ or unacceptable ACK (RFC 793 §3.4 p37)
approach:
[Objective]
Mirror of UNACCEPTABLE_09 for FW2.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Handshake → CLOSE → FW1 → tester ACK → FW2.
2. Tester sends OTW-SEQ data.
3. DUT corrective ACK.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted corrective ACK observed.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_no_dut_fin — no DUT FIN
• Fail_no_data_ack — no DUT corrective ACK

verdicts.Fail_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK within listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_dut_fin: No DUT FIN within listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_data_ack: No DUT ACK to OTW-SEQ in FW2
